claim_boundary: The repository-local G0 development tranche is accepted with explicit deferrals. These records do not certify G0, G1, either A1 reference board, a model, an inference runtime, production signing custody, or a service class.

items.subject: critical-architecture-directions
items.notes: The decisions are frozen inputs, but implementation and conformance evidence remain separate.

items.subject: windows-development-host-inventory
items.notes: One physical development laptop is not the required pair of named A1 boards.

items.subject: ubuntu-26.04-wsl-evaluation-path
items.notes: The guest supports development and compatibility experiments only; it is not the Ubuntu 24.04 reproducible baseline or physical-board evidence.

items.subject: nvidia-gpu-telemetry
items.notes: RTX 3050 presence, nominal VRAM, and /dev/dxg presence do not prove model load, correctness, isolation, performance, or recovery.

items.subject: initial-test-registers
items.notes: Owners and status are present; planned or blocked entries are not test results.

items.subject: initial-secret-dependency-and-interface-review
items.notes: The targeted working-tree scan and manifest review passed; history/provider scanning and current dynamic interface evidence remain open.

items.subject: initial-ci-lanes
items.notes: Ubuntu full checks, focused fake/G1 contracts, native Windows contract smoke, and reproducible source-package lanes are declared; configuration is not a passing run.

items.subject: current-repository-check
items.notes: The retained dependency-free repository check and reproducibility run passed on WSL 26.04. It is historical development evidence; the current revision must pass the final validation run, and WSL cannot close formal G0.

items.subject: governing-source-ingestion-and-traceability
items.notes: The supplied governing DOCX files are pinned and all 288 requirements have source text, acceptance/reference data, and source locators. Plan-derived gate mappings remain distinct from source traceability, and source verification is not product acceptance.

items.subject: admin-governance-and-delegation-decision
items.notes: Admin is the fixed product super-role for finite declared role/activity assignment. It is not Windows Administrator or Linux root and does not establish protected production signing custody.

items.subject: current-development-environments-and-model-baseline
items.notes: Native Windows and Ubuntu 26.04 WSL on the same laptop are accepted as current development lanes. The selected 1.7B model is a smoke baseline, not the governed 4–6B control-model result or a second physical-board result.

closure_rule: Development work may proceed under the explicit deferral register. Formal G0 may be marked passed only after every certification blocker is resolved with retained evidence on the governed environments and the development-plan exit criteria are independently reviewed.
